summary: Backend testing for the new Chats-tab DM endpoints. All 15 tests PASSED (100%). Covered the new POST /api/dm/{conv_id}/mark-read, new GET /api/dm/{user_id}/unread-total, and the enhanced GET /api/dm/{user_id}/conversations (unread_count + other.status), plus an end-to-end unread → mark-read → 0 flow between two freshly-signed-up users, plus the regression trio (/api/health, /api/auth/login, /api/auth/me). Owner-only auth (403), missing-bearer (401/403), non-participant (403) and non-existent-conv (404) branches all behave correctly. Persistence verified via MongoDB (last_read_at.{uid} set after mark-read).
critical_code_review_comments: Note: There is no HTTP POST /api/messages endpoint — DM messages travel over WebSocket only. The review request mentioned 'POST /api/messages OR WebSocket'; for the E2E steps 10-12 I inserted the Message document directly into MongoDB (localhost) to simulate a WS send, exercising the exact same fields the WS handler writes (dm_id, user_id, text, created_at). If the frontend Chats tab is supposed to have an HTTP send path, it is currently missing.

unread_count fallback comment in server.py:7981-7983 says 'fall back to counting messages from the peer only' — the code actually always excludes the caller (user_id: {$ne: user_id}) which is correct; the comment is slightly misleading but not a bug.
server.py is now 9419 lines — well past the 700-line guideline. Recommend splitting into feature modules (dm.py, auth.py, admin.py, games/*.py, community.py) in a future refactor iteration.
seed_data_creation: Created 3 TEST_* signup accounts (A/B/C) and one DM conversation between A and B. Best-effort cleanup runs at module teardown (delete_many on users/dm_conversations/messages). Any residual TEST_ prefixed users are safe to delete from Mongo.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Test file /app/backend/tests/test_iter62_dm_chats_tab.py is reusable — it self-signs-up fresh users per module, so it can be re-run any time. It reads MONGO_URL/DB_NAME from env (defaults to mongodb://localhost:27017 / test_database). If DM messages ever get an HTTP send endpoint, swap the _insert_message helper for an HTTP POST call.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no issues found. All new endpoints behave per spec (auth-gated, correct status codes, correct schema, correct DB side-effects).
